brief:
Israeli forces killed 11 Palestinians, including two children, in drone attacks and shootings across Gaza between 16 and 18 November, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. Several others, including children, were wounded in the strikes across multiple areas of the Strip.

The operations coincided with an escalation in home demolitions and forced displacement of residents in northern al-Nuseirat, according to the rights group. Israeli forces announced they had launched new operations during the period.
